name: aidrian-harness
description: Shared AI harness: generic agents and skills that work from each project's own knowledge buckets.

plugins.name: aidrian
plugins.description: An engineering crew of agents (orchestrator, planning, architecture, product, development, review, security, design, support, and marketing), the skills that drive it from plan to pull request, safety hooks, and the aidrian command. Each project supplies its rules and settings in one project folder.
